/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Micro.name: Kinemantik™ Announce
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Micro.desc: The Kinemantik™ Announce is compatible with all major systems. With an adjustable in-line volume override, it is sure to muster even the most stubborn of troops.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Micro.name: KineKitchen™ Microwave

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Notep.desc: File-a-Style™ notepads come in packages of 10 and are lined.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Offic.name: File-a-Style™ Office Phone
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Offic.desc: The File-a-Style™ Office Phone comes with nine hold lines for busy days, dial-out settings, and new digital voicemail features with TWO optional voice settings!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.name: KineMagik!™ Boom Box
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.desc: The KineMagik!™ Boom Box is for when you want to make sure that the entire neighborhood shares in your tunes!

The Kinemantik At Home (K.A.H.)™ Game Monitor is the best way to run your K.A.H. system at home with perfect 64-bit definition. 

(Note: The K.A.H. Game System is only compatible with the K.A.H. Game Monitor and will not work with any other TV or monitor.)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.name: KineMagik!™ Portable TV
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.desc: Take your shows on the road with this KineMagik!™ portable TV with included tuner!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.name: Kinemantik™ Speaker

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.name: Kinemantik™ Speaker System
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.desc: This Kinemantik™ Speaker System with Amp is the all-in-one solution for anyone who wants to listen to their favorite tunes at full volume! Compatible with all KineMagik!™ headphones.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.name: Kinemantik™ Digital Video Camera
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Packa.desc: Take the show on the road with this amazing Kinemantik™ DIGITAL Video Camera! Welcome to the future with the world of digital video recording! With an attached polycrystalline-silicon LCD monitor, you'll be the talk of the neighborhood!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Party.desc: For all your KineBasik™ Party needs!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Penci.name: File-a-Style™ Pencils

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Pillo.name: KineBasik™ Pillows

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Pizza.name: KineBasik™ Pizza Boxes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Pizza.desc: For all your KineBasik™ pizza boxing needs! (Note: Pizza not included.)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Plant.name: KineBasik™ Hanging Planter
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Plant.desc: For all your KineBasik™ plant-hanging needs! Bring a little bit of nature inside.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Propa.name: Green Gorilla™ Propane Tank
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Propa.desc: Green Gorilla™ Propane is more than just propane. It's propane in a tank.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Scoot.name: The Scooticle™
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Scoot.desc: The ZeViLa Scooticle™ might seem like it pales in comparison to its bigger sibling the Atomiccycle, but the engineers behind the powerful and popular motorcycle spared no expense when they designed its smaller, city-friendly sibling!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Sign.name: KineBasik™ Assorted Roadsigns
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Sign.desc: For all your KineBasik Assorted Roadsign Needs!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Stick.name: File-a-Style™ Sticky Notes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Stick.desc: File-a-Style™ Sticky Notes come in packages of 100 in assorted colors.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Telev.name: Kinemantik™ 840HD TV
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Telev.desc: The Kinemantik™ 840 HD TV is the top-of-the-line cathode-ray tube television set, showing all your favorite programs in their beautiful 4:3 aspect ratio!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Toast.name: KineKitchen™ Toaster
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Toast.desc: The KineKitchen™ toaster comes with four sets of electrical coils and ten heat settings for that perfect crispy breakfast!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Toast.name: KineKitchen™ Toaster Oven
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Toast.desc: The KineKitchen™ Toaster Oven is perfect for those smaller kitchens or cooking on the go, where a full kitchen isn't available. It's amazing what you can make with it's broil and convection settings!

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Video.name: "Circle of Comrades" Series on VHS
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Gifts/Video.desc: The critically acclaimed 'Circle of Comrades' complete series on VHS. 6-Tape Boxed Set.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.name: Efervon Sample
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.desc: A sample of the corrosive substance that Scaldra use to purge Techrot. Handle with care.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.name: Höllvanian Pitchweave Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.desc: An Efervon-resistant material used to craft Scaldra uniforms.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.name: Beating Heartstrings
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.desc: These curious Techrot growths still quivered in sympathy with Temple’s music long after the gig was over.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.name: Techrot Motherboard
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.desc: This motherboard likely served as a nerve center, facilitating the Techrot’s communication network.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.name: Techrot Chitin
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.desc: This twisted husk barely resembles the electronic device it once was, consumed and reshaped by the Techrot’s relentless spread.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.name: Experimental Arc-Relay
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/1.desc: Höllvanian ingenuity knows no bounds, and this unregulated marvel is proof! A cutting-edge device brimming with untamed innovation.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Inaak
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Xiran
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Haav
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Namaes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Seonn
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Nacreous Pebble
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: Collectors like to marvel at the peculiar origin of Nacreous Pebbles. Their beauty is the result of ordinary pebbles having been ingested and regurgitated by the Golden Maw.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.where: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Ariette Scale
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: Each Duviri fish species has distinct features, but they all evolved beautiful chromatic scales.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.where: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Maw Fang
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.desc: Looks like someone got carried away during a delicious meal.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.where: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Pathos Clamp
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: The manifestation of Thrax's malevolence that shapes the Orowyrms' outbursts.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.where: Rewarded upon defeating the Orowyrm in Duviri

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Tertium
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Its power lies in its potential.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Rune Marrow
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Rune Marrow erupts from Duviri’s core.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Kullervo's Bane
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Kullervo's fury incarnate. Acrithis will trade this prized artifact for certain items from her collection.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.where: Earned by confronting Kullervo and defeating the Orowyrm in the same Duviri mission during the Fear, Anger, or Sorrow spiral

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Tasoma Extract
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Duviri citizens plagued by nightmares seek Tasoma, because its stalks can be crushed to create juice that invites pleasant dreams. Unfortunately, it is difficult to forage Tasoma as it only grows in caves.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Tasoma Spore
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: A Tasoma fungal spore, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Kovnik
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Duviri citizens harvest Kovnik leaves to blend invigorating teas.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Eevani
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Duviri citizens have been known to mash Eevani leaves into a paste that alleviates the discomfort caused by fresh wounds.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Connla Sprout
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: The water that courses through Connla Sprouts tastes sweet and refreshing.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Yao Shrub
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: The warm light of the Yao Shrub glows even within cold dark places.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Silphsela
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: It is traditionally held that to see Silphsela floating in the air heralds an imminent change in the sky.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Dracroot
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Ueymag
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Ueymag meat is said to be delicious. Just mind the barbs.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Saggen Pearl
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Enigma Gyrum
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.where: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Aggristone
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.desc: It is said that Aggri Formations are hardened saliva from mighty Orowyrms. Duviri citizens believe Aggristones are powerful talismans.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.name: Temporal Dust
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.desc:
The dust of decayed universes, rich in entropy. Entrati's research postulates it as the animating agent of the nightmarish Murmur.

Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.name: Scuttler Husk
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.desc:
A remnant of battle with Oraxia, the spider that once wore this skin is gone… though it is not easy to tell where.

Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.name: Dominus Aureus
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.desc:
Stolen golden seals emblematic of royal authority in Duviri. Return them to restore Dominus Thrax to the throne.

Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Condroc Wing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: The talon on a condroc's wing is sharp enough to tear through bone.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Cetus Wisp
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: Most common at night, these stone lifeforms are drawn to shorelines touched by the Eidolon. They linger around lakes on the Plains of Eidolon at all hours. Their origin remains mysterious.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Maprico
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: This hardy fruit is thick-skinned to withstand harsh conditions, concealing a mouthful of sweet pulp within.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Kuaka Spinal Claw
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: The sinew from the Kuaka's spinal claws can be tanned to make resilient and flexible leather.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Grokdrul
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: A noxious mix of polysaccharides and long-chain polymers, Grokdrul is a standard chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Iradite
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: A mineral valuable to the Ostrons.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Nistlepod
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: Used by the Nistlebrush to trap and kill prey.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Riven Transmuter
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.desc: Combine multiple Rivens to create a new, different Riven.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Curse of Knowing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Curse of Hearing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Curse of Seeing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Grotesque Splinter
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: A foreboding fragment of the vast Indifference.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Entrati Obols
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: During the Orokin era, these obols were a commonly recognized mark of the Entrati family. Some Archimedeans even used them as good luck talismans.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Necracoil
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: This experimental array transmutes Void energy into high voltages with low currents.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Entrati Lanthorn
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Stela
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.desc: This Void-touched stone contains an ominous essence.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.desc: A cognition matrix that enables mechs to be adaptable and efficient in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.where: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 3 Isolation Vault Bounties

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Orokin ballistics matrix
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.desc: A mech matrix that assists with the machine's weapon accuracy and control.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.where: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 2 Isolation Vault Bounties

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Scintillant
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.desc: These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Pustulite
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.desc: Half-formed, incomplete spore bearers, little more than twitching flesh with claws to latch on with.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Ganglion
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.desc: A fallen clump of entangled nerve fibers, redundant organs, and thin sensory membranes.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Lucent Teroglobe
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.desc: These orbs have long since fulfilled their original function, but still, thrum with faint power.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.name: Volatile Motes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.desc:
Highly charged particles of pure energy. The source of the Jade Light, and Jade's power. Highly coveted by Parvos Granum for his Jade Eximus program.

Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.name: Nightmare Tatters
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.desc:
The ragged remnants of hopes and dreams can be recreated with patient persistence.

Obtained by completing Follie's Hunt missions on Vesper Relay and Nightmare missions during Operation: Atramentum.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.name: Atramentum
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.desc:
This deep black ink has the power to reveal hidden truth.

Obtained from Atramentum Balloons and completing Follie's Hunt missions (Vesper Relay). Exchanged with Aspirant Zorba in any Relay.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.name: Ignia
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.desc: The passionate heat of flames fuels the path to redemption.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.where: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.name: Maphica
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.desc: A core of rage, jealously guarded in a burnished shell.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.where: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Ren Hypercore
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.desc:
The evolved core of a Dactolyst, bearing its true self-given name and identity. When deprived of Tau pollen, the core becomes susceptible to forcible reprogramming.

Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Lyroic Bridge
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.desc:
A delicate paraneural interface allowing a duly evolved Sentient pilot to command the colossal Hunhullus as if it were a second skin.

Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Ascaris Prime
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.desc:
Technology developed by Executor Ballas to allow remote piloting of a hijacked Warframe for short periods, forcing them to act against even their deepest instincts.

Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Agnovidisc
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.desc: A mark of identification carried by soldiers during The Old War so that their names might be remembered if they never returned home.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.where: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Servoris
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.desc: Medals awarded to Orokin soldiers during The Old War for acts of distinguished service.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.where: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Laudavi
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.desc: Awarded to soldiers during the The Old War for distinction in battle.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.where: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.name: Crisma Toroid
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.desc:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Crisma Toroids by defeating the Profit-Taker Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.name: Lazulite Toroid
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.desc:

Earn Lazulite Toroids by defeating the Exploiter Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.name: Calda Toroid
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.desc:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Calda Toroids from enemies located at the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis and from Scyto Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.name: Vega Toroid
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.desc:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Vega Toroids from enemies located at the Spaceport in the Orb Vallis and from Mite Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.name: Sola Toroid
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ar.desc:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Sola Toroids from enemies located at the Temple of Profit in the Orb Vallis and from Kyta Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Thermal Sludge
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.desc: A by-product from the Weeping Towers terraforming processes.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Gyromag Systems
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.desc: A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.where: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Atmo Systems
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.desc: A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.where: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Repeller Systems
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.desc: Anti-gravity system that allows massively heavy objects to be manipulated by a single user.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.where: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Fu.name: Mytocardia Spore
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Fu.desc: A fungal body prized for its varied uses.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Or.name: Orokin Monitor
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Or.desc: These Orokin devices emerge when the floating glaciers impact on the surface of Venus. Their purpose is unknown.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.name: Gorgaricus Spore
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.desc: The reproductive spore of the giant Vallis fungi is highly coveted for the complex chemical compounds it contains.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.name: Frostcap
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.desc: Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.name: Tepa Nodule
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.desc: The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Thrax Plasm
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.desc: Found in the remnants of Thrax Void manifestations, this plasm has several surprisingly practical applications.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Voidgel Orb
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.desc: A sample of ambient Void energy distilled into a neutral state.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Entrati Lanthorn
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.desc: A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Charc Electroplax
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
Harvested by the Ostron as a catalyst used in their synthetics.

Source: Cut from Charc Eels via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Charc Eels in the Plains of Eidolon lake at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Goopolla Spleen
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins.

Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Murkray Liver
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
An ingredient used in Ostron cooking and medicine.

Source: Cut from Murkray fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Murkray in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots at any time of day using Murkray Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Sharrac Teeth
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
These will often adorn ceremonial garb or as a reagent for synthetics.

Source: Cut from Sharrac fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Sharrac in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Karkina Antenna
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
Ground into a powder this substance can makes fires burn hotter for a brief amount of time.

Source: Cut from Karkina fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Karkina in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Mawfish Bones
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
The bones of the Mawfish are carved by the Ostron to produce ornaments and tools.

Source: Cut from Mawfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mawfish in the Plains of Eidolon lake during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Khut-Khut Venom Sac
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
The poison is used to cure leather and as a reagent to produce an embalming fluid.

Source: Cut from Khut-Khut fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Khut-Khut in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Yogwun Stomach
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
Once cleaned and tanned this organ can be turned into a durable leather.

Source: Cut from Yogwun fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Yogwun in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Tralok Eyes
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.desc:
The Ostron boil these into a jelly which forms a strong adhesive when it dries.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KelaArenaTo.name: Judgement Points
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KelaArenaTo.desc:
Points earned through victories in Rathuum.

Obtained from Rathuum Arena missions on Nakki, Yam, and Vodyanoi (Sedna).

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.name: Kuva
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.desc: Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.where: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.name: Somatic Fibers
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.desc: Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.where: Demolishers on Apollo (Lua), and Conjunction Survival Missions (Lua)

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.name: Orokin Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.desc: This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.where: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.name: Morphics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.desc: An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.where: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.name: Fergolyte
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.desc: This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.name: Nano Spores
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.desc: Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.name: Narmer Isoplast
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.desc: An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.where: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.name: Nav Coordinate
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.desc: Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NeuralSenso.name: Neural Sensors
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NeuralSenso.desc: Implanted neural-link for controlling augmentations. Grineer design.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Neurode.name: Neurodes
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Neurode.desc: Biotech sensor organ harvested from Infested entities.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop.name: Omega Isotope
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop.desc: Produced by a Fomorian's power core, these particles only appear on or around planets where a Fomorian is present.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop.where: When a Balor Fomorian is threatening a Planet's Relay, enemies on that Planet will drop this resource

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCell.name: Orokin Cell
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCell.desc: Ancient energy cell from the Orokin era.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.name: Oxium
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.desc: Oxium is a rare lighter than air alloy of Orokin origin, used in certain Corpus Robotics.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.where: Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, and Lua.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Plastids.name: Plastids
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Plastids.where: Phobos, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, and Eris

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PolymerBund.name: Polymer Bundle
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PolymerBund.desc: A hard, thermoplastic casing. Manufactured by Corpus.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi.name: Cryptographic Alu
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi.desc: Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi.where: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.name: Riven Sliver
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.desc: A fragment of a sundered Riven. It is known that, with enough slivers, Palladino is capable of reforging a complete Riven. Find her in the Iron Wake (Earth) after completing The Chains of Harrow quest.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.name: Veiled Riven Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.desc: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo.name: Rubedo
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo.desc: A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo.where: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage.name: Salvage
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage.desc: High value metals collected from war salvage.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.name: Aya
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.desc: Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.name: Anomaly Shard
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.desc: A shard ripped from a Sentient Anomaly in the Veil Proxima. Little Duck is known to trade these for other exotic goods somewhere in Fortuna on Venus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.where: Murex ships found in Veil Proxima nodes marked with a special flashing icon (Railjack)

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.name: Spectral Debris
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.desc: Discharged specter particles form an inert dust that can be collected and re-energized for various robotic projects.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.where: Errant Specters in the Granum Void (Corpus Ship Tileset)

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.name: Steel Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.desc: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SyringeComp.name: Antiserum Injector Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SyringeComp.desc: A component of the Antiserum Injector.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Tellurium.name: Tellurium
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Tellurium.desc: This rare metal is foreign to the Origin System and can only be found in asteroids that have made the long journey from other stars.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ValenceAdap.name: Elemental Vice
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ValenceAdap.desc: Use the Elemental Vice to change the Elemental Damage Type of an Adversary Weapon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VoidTearDro.name: Void Traces
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VoidTearDro.desc: A substance used to increase the power within Relics.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.name: Sunlight Threshcone
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.desc: This common plant can only be found during the day.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.where: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.name: Moonlight Threshcone
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.desc: This common plant can only be found at night.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.where: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/GftP.name: Ruk's Claw
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/GftP.desc: This plant was introduced to arid regions across the Origin System, for its ability to collect moisture in harsh environments.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/GftP.where: Obtained by gathering Ruk's Claw plants that grow on Mars

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Moss.name: Vestan Moss
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Moss.desc: One of the few known plant species able to thrive on asteroids in deep space.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Moss.where: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroF.name: Cerulean Fungus Extract
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroF.desc: Extracted from a Cerulean Fungus colony.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Rare.name: Sunlight Jadeleaf
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Rare.desc: This rare plant can only be found during the day.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Rare.where: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Rare.name: Moonlight Jadeleaf
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Rare.desc: This rare plant can only be found at night.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Rare.where: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/UnCo.name: Sunlight Dragonlily
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/UnCo.desc: This uncommon plant can only be found during the day.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/UnCo.where: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/UnCo.name: Moonlight Dragonlily
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/UnCo.desc: This uncommon plant can only be found at night.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/UnCo.where: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Wild.name: Frostleaf
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Wild.desc: This resilient plant provides a natural food source in frigid areas of the Origin system.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Wild.where: Obtained by gathering Frostleaf plants that grow on Venus, Neptune, and Pluto

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenC.name: Dusklight Sarracenia
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenC.desc: This robust, carnivorous plant has adapted to conditions in polluted waters.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenC.where: Obtained by gathering Dusklight Sarracenia plants growing in Grineer Shipyards found commonly on Ceres

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenP.name: Lunar Pitcher
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenP.desc: This carnivorous plant can be found growing in the wilderness on Lua.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenP.where: Obtained by gathering Lunar Pitcher plants that grow on Lua

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Ast.name: Asterite
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Ast.desc: Formed over billions of years, these crystals are most often found embedded in space rock.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Auc.name: Aucrux Capacitors
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Auc.desc: Once installed, these delicate power systems fuse with a Corpus Obelisk's engines. Unused capacitors are therefore, highly prized.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Auc.where: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Bra.name: Bracoid
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Bra.desc: A rare bacterial entity that increases the spread of Infestation found on Infested Ships.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Car.name: Carbides
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Car.desc: Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Car.where: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cop.name: Copernics
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cop.desc: A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cub.name: Cubic Diodes
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cub.desc: Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cub.where: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Fre.name: Fresnels
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Fre.desc: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Gal.name: Gallos Rods
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Gal.desc: Antimatter fuel cell that powers the Grineer Ships.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Gal.where: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Iso.name: Isos
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Iso.desc: A self-replicating fluid comprised of nanoproxies capable of independently repairing worn and damaged systems.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Iso.where: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kes.name: Kesslers
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kes.desc: Orokin devices used for navigating the solar winds.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kom.name: Komms
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kom.desc: A component used in secure Grineer communication networks.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kom.where: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Nul.name: Nullstones
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Nul.desc: Nullstones do not conform to several laws of physics, making them highly prized for optimizing sensitive components.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Pus.name: Pustrels
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Pus.desc: A parasitic growth that often infects Eximus units operating in Infested environs.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Scr.name: Ticor Plate
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Scr.desc: High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tit.name: Titanium
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tit.desc: This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tra.name: Trachons
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tra.desc: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioComponent.name: Mutagen Mass
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioComponent.desc: This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioComponent.where: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioFragment.name: Mutagen Sample
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioFragment.desc: These samples could advance our knowledge of biological research.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemComponen.name: Detonite Injector
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemComponen.desc: Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemComponen.where: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemFragment.name: Detonite Ampule
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemFragment.desc: Researching the Detonite traces within could advance our weapon technology.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemFragment.where: Venus, Earth, Lua, Ceres, Saturn, Sedna, and the Kuva Fortress

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyCompon.name: Fieldron
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyCompon.desc: ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyCompon.where: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyFragme.name: Fieldron Sample
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyFragme.desc: This destroyed Fieldron could further research into super-heated containment fields.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyFragme.where: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune, and Pluto

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.name: Training debt-bond
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.desc:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.name: Shelter debt-bond
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.desc:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.name: Medical debt-bond
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.desc:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.name: Advances debt-bond
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.desc:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.name: Familial debt-bond
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.desc:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Items/Tokens/GreedTokens/Gr.name: Zenith Granum Crown
/Lotus/Types/Items/Tokens/GreedTokens/Gr.desc: An ancient token of highest esteem from the Corpus Founder himself. The rarest of all.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Tokens/GreedTokens/Gr.name: Granum Crown
/Lotus/Types/Items/Tokens/GreedTokens/Gr.desc: An ancient token of esteem from the Corpus Founder himself.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Tokens/GreedTokens/Gr.desc: An ancient token of high esteem from the Corpus Founder himself.
